<threat_model>
## Trust Boundaries

| Boundary | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| vendor/galago-tools → codegen | External repo's frozen proto is the input to generated source; a wrong/moved input silently changes the wire |
| codegen toolchain → generated files | protoc resolves plugins from PATH; the wrong plugin version (1.153.2) emits broken output |
| commandFields → command panel | Anything listed in commandFields.stack becomes operator-sendable from the tool page |

## STRIDE Threat Register

| Threat ID | Category | Component | Severity | Disposition | Mitigation Plan |
|-----------|----------|-----------|----------|-------------|-----------------|
| T-05-01 | Tampering | protoc plugin resolution during regen | high | mitigate | Explicit `--plugin=` to the pinned 1.151.1 scratch-dir binary; `tsc --noEmit` gate immediately after regen catches the documented 1.153.2 breakage (Task 2) |
